profile.bio:
Everything decays. Proof remains.
The Half-Life Archive — 1,000 Subjects on Base.
Lore, provenance, and an honest build log.

pinnedThread: Half-Life Archive: 1,000 Subjects, five factions, one sealed city called Vanta.
Every Subject is a witness with a record, a memory fragment and a chapter connection.
The collection, lore, contract and safer checkout are public. No invented rarity. No guaranteed utility.
Enter the archive: https://decaylabs.online — verify first, then choose your next witness.
